attributes.alt: A brick factory hall with a sawtooth roof and tall steel windows on a paved square at Dok Noord, Ghent

children.innerHTML:
One designer,
one model-maker on call.
I work from a shared workshop by the docks in Ghent.
I keep every sketch, and at the end of a job you get the whole box.
Before going independent I spent eight years drawing lamps for a lighting company.
